blind.description: A square stone dungeon-style pressure plate. It consists of a dark charcoal stone outer rim frame with segmented border blocks and corner details, housing a raised square inner mechanism plate made of smooth beige-grey stone. The inner pad features a shallow circular dished depression in the center with four faint radial groove notches extending toward the edges. Geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled.
blind.from_above: A square concentric frame with dark outer borders containing segmented stone edges, enclosing a lighter square stone tile with a circular concave indentation in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely low, roughly 4 to 6 inches tall (barely reaching ankle height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and approximately 2.5 to 3 feet wide square.
